concepts.name: 01-xich-giap-nguyet-tuong
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production character concept turnaround for a new male Legendary Lord in Total War Warhammer III, Moon Warden, human swordsman and commander with healing and destructive spellcasting, no dragon transformation. Strong visual inspiration from premodern Dai Viet Vietnamese military clothing and decorative arts, adapted into grounded dark fantasy, NOT a claim of exact historical reconstruction. Vietnamese facial features and black hair, mature adult, dignified and formidable rather than monstrous. Create a polished detailed full-body character design sheet with exactly TWO full body views of THE SAME design: a strictly straight-on FRONT elevation on the left and a true 90-degree SIDE profile facing right on the right. Match stature, face, hair, every armor panel, belt, fabric length and footwear between views, aligned on a common ground line, neutral standing pose with hands relaxed away from torso. Orthographic presentation without perspective foreshortening, no three-quarter view. Include ONE small separate sword design in the margin, straight single-hand double-edged blade with clearly defined hilt, fantasy Vietnamese-inspired fittings; empty hands on both bodies so costume anatomy remains visible for modeling. Both bodies visible from top of head to soles with ample margins. Clean warm pale gray background, subtle ground shadows, professional painted game concept with realistic readable material rendering and crisp silhouettes. Clear construction seams, layered clothing and armor plates. Restrained crescent-moon emblem integrated in belt or chest, unlit materials, no floating particles or magical effects obscuring costume. Avoid Qing queues, Manchu robes, samurai armor, Japanese katana, European knight plate suit, modern flags, oversized horns, giant spiked pauldrons, generic Chinese TV emperor costume, extra people, extra views, text paragraphs, watermark. Only small headings FRONT and SIDE and the concept number.
CONCEPT 01 — CRIMSON FIELD COMMANDER. Practical bold martial silhouette, stocky athletic Vietnamese man around 40 with short moustache and close trimmed beard, exposed face, black hair tied in a compact high bun with a dark red cloth binding, NO helmet. Dense dark reddish-brown lacquered small lamellar plates over an overlapping cross-collar deep crimson woven tunic, bronze edging and sturdy segmented shoulder guards sitting close to shoulders. Broad vermilion cloth waist sash with a small silver crescent buckle, split armored skirt to upper calves, wrapped trousers, black leather ankle boots. Small lotus and curling cloud engravings, weathered bronze, no dragon heads. Clearly visible pale inner collar and red garment hems. Restrained short dark red back mantle kept behind silhouette and side view shows attachment. Sword design with aged bronze lotus guard, dark grip and clean straight blade. Emphasize recognizable Vietnamese-inspired layered military dress, compact functional armor, warm red and bronze, battlefield authority.

CONCEPT 02 — BLACK LACQUER GRAND GENERAL. Taller broad-shouldered mature Vietnamese man around 48, strong square face, neatly trimmed short beard, wearing a compact low rounded black iron military helmet with a modest central ridge, bronze rim and short layered neck defense, no wings and no fantasy horns. Heavy black lacquer brigandine-like armored long coat with orderly small bronze rivet rows and an overlapping round-collar indigo underrobe, dense dark lamellar shoulder and thigh defenses, wide bronze belt carrying an engraved silver crescent roundel. CONCEPT 03 — IVORY SCHOLAR GENERAL. Lean athletic Vietnamese man around 35, intelligent calm face, clean shaven, black hair tied in a tidy bun partly enclosed by a simple dark wrapped cloth headpiece, no metal helmet. Elegant ivory overlapping cross-collar long robe with narrow practical sleeves and side slits, restrained blue-gray silver small-scale cuirass over the torso, slim segmented silver forearm guards, small articulated shoulder plates, high dark navy fabric waist sash and pale silver crescent clasp. Clear layered white robe panels ending mid-shin with dark teal edge, fitted dark trousers and soft black boots. Lotus blossom and rippling-water border embroidery, subtle scholarly commander influence with functional sword-fighter mobility. No cape, no floating scarves, no staff, no armor spikes. This is a formidable human warrior healer lord, NOT a priest or wizard in baggy sleeves. Ivory, muted teal and silver palette. Single separate straight sword with lotus-shaped silver guard, navy grip, pale unlit blade. Silhouette distinctly slender, refined and fabric-led rather than bulky armor.
